title: Yummy Sweet Greek Beef Stew
description: A sweet, tender Greek beef stew with caramelized honey, aromatic herbs, and blanched spinach, perfect for a midnight craving.
instructions: Heat the Tajine over medium flame and drizzle olive oil into it.
Add the beef cubes and sear until browned on all sides.
Pour in the red wine, letting it reduce slightly for 2 minutes.
Stir in honey and tomato paste, coating the meat evenly.
Add water, oregano, thyme, bay leaf, and salt, then bring to a gentle simmer.
Reduce heat to low, cover the Tajine, and let the stew cook for 60 minutes.
While the stew simmers, blanch the spinach in boiling water for 1 minute, then plunge into ice water and drain.
After 60 minutes, stir in the blanched spinach and lemon juice, and simmer uncovered for another 15 minutes.
Adjust seasoning with more salt or honey if needed, then remove from heat.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh oregano leaves if desired.
